tweets.text:
There tends to be a debate between being an expert or generalist in the era of AI. So far, the experts appear to have the upper hand, and that’s not slowing down.

AI makes it 10X easier to get started with any kind of task. Coding, legal work, research, financial analysis, and so on. But having the right judgment for how to direct the agent onto the right work, how to veer it to course correct it, being able to review or test the output, and having the right sense of what “good” looks like all requires a high degree of skill depending on the field.

That skill can be developed far faster due to AI for anyone interested, which is amazing for uplifting anyone in their career. But there’s no replacement to needing judgment and many of the core skills that go into most domains of work. 

And if anything, AI will be a technology that exacerbates differences in skill levels because the experts have far more leverage than ever before. Net net: don’t give up on being an expert at something.

据 Arkham 链上数据显示，标记为 BlackRock（贝莱德）的 IBIT 比特币 ETF 地址，在过去两天内，正持续不断地从 Coinbase Prime 托管热钱包中接收 BTC 转入。

这意味着，美股传统金融市场对现货 ETF 的申购需求极其旺盛，场外合规资金正在加速涌入加密市场。

机构的结算划转操作非常规整，几乎每笔转账都精准控制在 300 BTC 左右。

Probably Nothing. 📈

今天，地产枭雄许家印一审被判处无期徒刑，迎来了注定的结局。

而在追溯相关资产时，讨论的焦点放在了其潜逃海外的前妻丁玉梅身上。

早在之前案发时，其实就有一些网传的阴谋论猜测，丁玉梅早已通过各种隐秘通道将巨额财富隐形化；这里面自然也少不了加密货币的猜疑。

丁玉梅在海外的资产动作其实非常高调且频繁。
据英国及香港法庭文件披露，她在恒大暴雷前的“技术性离婚”中卷走了数百亿股息。

随后她潜逃英国，在伦敦大手笔通过 5 家离岸空壳公司买下了价值近 5000 万英镑（约 5.2 亿港元）的豪华公寓。甚至在全球追讨的压力下，她还在频繁转账、变现资产，并试图注销其名下的海外关联公司来断开线索。

由于这一系列密集的资产转移，香港及英国法院之前对其下发了“全球资产冻结令”，直接锁死了其账面上能看到的 600 亿港币资产。

但恒大清盘人明确指控：这只是冰山一角，丁玉梅仍隐匿了 200 亿至 400 亿港元 的“隐藏资产”未向法庭申报。

在传统 CeFi 账户无处可藏的绝境下，这几百亿尚未曝光的隐匿资金，无论是网传隐藏极深的“非洲锂矿股权”，还是去中心化的“加密冷钱包”，
都成了坊间推测她效仿当年英国“蓝天格锐案”（钱志敏藏匿 6.1 万枚 BTC）用来避险的怀疑对象。

但这些被隐藏的资产，本质上都是无数普通业主和投资人的血汗钱、保命钱。

无论她是通过传统离岸信托漂白，还是利用加密冷钱包藏匿，、我们希望时间终将揭露所有的欺诈行径，迎来应有的法律审判与资产清算。

Jim Cramer 又一次精准踩中反指了😂

8 月初他公开宣布“卖掉全部比特币，因为量子威胁”，当时 $BTC 还在 6.4 万附近。

昨晚，BTC 盘中放量暴涨一度逼近 7 万美元大关，24 小时暴涨超 7%，创下 3 月以来最大单日涨幅，顺带爆掉约 11 亿美元比特币空单。

顺便复习一下他的反指历史：

2008 年 3 月：“Bear Stearns 没问题！别撤钱！”→几天后股价从 60 刀崩到 2 刀
2008 年 10 月：恐慌喊“未来 5 年要用的钱赶紧出市场”→后来市场见底大反弹 400%+
2011-2013：分别看空 Apple、Amazon、Tesla、Netflix（称已见顶/要破产）→这些股后来涨了十几倍到几十倍
2022 年 12 月：“再也不碰加密货币了，卖掉全部”→BTC 从 1.68 万起步涨超 400%
2022 年底：把 SBF 比作现代 J.P. Morgan→FTX 几天后崩盘
2015 年：把 Elizabeth Holmes 比作 Steve Jobs→Theranos 造假曝光，她进监狱
2023 年 2 月：猛推 SVB 为“2023 大赢家”→一个月后银行倒闭
2023 年 3 月：还夸 First Republic Bank→随后股价暴跌 80%+破产

Inverse Cramer never fails.

这次会不会又是底部信号🤔

tweets.text:
#BTC 

Bitcoin has had macro price action clusters develop throughout the entire Bear Cycle, with fake-breakouts

If you believe the bottom is in, that's absolutely fine

But in that case, Bitcoin will need to sustain itself at these highs to confirm that that bias is worth holding

And the reality is that Bitcoin technically, as per 4 Year Cycle tendencies, could have the time until the 31st of December 2026 to perform a Bear Market low

That's a lot of time

And if this is a Bear Market Relief Rally then time will likely verify this move, because strength isn't sustainable in Bear Cycles

$BTC #Bitcoin

#BTC 

What Bitcoin has taught us over the years is that it will produce periods of under-performance as part of mean-reversion before transitioning into over-performance

That over-performance also mean reverts with price transitioning back into under-performance

Bitcoin is now experiencing its strongest ever Bear Market August

September tends to be a typically bearish month for Bitcoin in Bear Markets

It's tempting to think September will be also bullish because of an unusually bullish August

But what if September just plays out as the normal bearish month it typically is, as part of mean reversion from current over-performance to under-performance once again?

$BTC #Bitcoin

#BTC 

One of the things to consider on this recent Bitcoin ascent:

Can it reclaim the 21-week EMA (green) as support?

In Bull Markets, naturally this EMA figures as a support

However, in Bear Markets this EMA tends to act as resistance or even a failed retesting region if price overextends too much to the upside

For Bitcoin to maintain its bullish strength, price would need to Weekly Close above the 21-week EMA and successfully retest it as support

Because otherwise, if BTC fails the EMA retest and turns this 21-week EMA back into a new resistance, it will replicate the early 2026 Relief Rally and revert to continuing its Downtrend

Generally, Bitcoin needs to confirm a breakout beyond its Macro Downtrend to confirm a new Macro Uptrend for Bitcoin

At the moment, price is still forming Macro Lower Highs

And in fact, Bitcoin would need to reclaim as support both the 21-week EMA (green) and the 50-week EMA (purple) to finally invalidate the Macro Lower Highs which history suggests could be too tall of an order to do at this moment in the cycle

$BTC #Bitcoin

tweets.text:
Let's tokenize everything.

Tokenization is one of the best ways for countries to "raise money", or attract FDI (Foreign Direct Investment).

Which country/company won't want to sell their (tokenized) stocks to everyone in the world?

I support tokenization on all blockchains. While this creates the "fragmented liquidity" problem, it is the fastest way to grow the sector, with multiple players pushing.

Fragmentation can be somewhat addressed if there is high interchangeability amongst different issuers, which is important.

Cup of tea?

tweets.text:
There is no "pure data" company.

Data is what's given, often implicitly by user action, and it is not a commodity: it is non-rivalrous, perishable, non-fungible, non-depletable, ~zero marginal cost, etc.

Google isn't a data company without users who run its apps.

Use @Brave. https://t.co/KgHKqKyD88

The web evolved so quickly, protocols for crawling and micropayments didn't have a chance (but see x402 MG work now, all hail the HTTP 402 response code).

Same thing happened with ads, which became a Turing Tarpit of JS-mediated ad tech (I've paid my dues; please use @Brave). https://t.co/3QDOsJX9Zu
